(b)  No report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and upto the date of this report.

statutory_dues.text:
vii)	According to the information and explanations given to us, in respect of statutory dues:

a) According to information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the books of account, and records, the Company has generally been regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues.
b) According to the information and explanations given to us, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of the above were in arrears as at 31st March, 2025 for a period of more than six months from the date on when they become payable.
c) According to the information and explanations given to us, there are no dues of income tax, duty of excise and service tax and value added tax have not been deposited with the appropriate authorities on account of any dispute.

operating_notes.text: Ritco secured ~₹49 crore in new business contracts in April 2026.
Ritco secured ~₹10.07 crore in new business contracts in May 2026.
Secured ₹119.55 Cr new business in September 2026, including 3-year contracts with BCPL (₹73.67 Cr) and HRRL Barmer (₹35.34 Cr).
Step-down subsidiary TrucksUp recorded ₹54 Cr FASTag GMV, ₹3.78 Cr vehicle financing disbursements, and ₹80.07 lakh subscription revenue in September 2026.

timeline.summary: Manmohan Singh Chadha (HUF), Karta, declared no new substantial shareholding in Ritco Logistics Limited as of March 31, 2026, with nil pledged shares.
Ritco Logistics secured ~₹49 crores in new transportation contracts in April 2026 and reported TrucksUp FASTag GMV crossing ₹25 crore.

Ritco Leasing & Finance Pvt. Ltd., promoter of Ritco Logistics Limited, declares no encumbrance or pledge of shares as of March 31, 2026, with **Man Mohan Pal Singh Chadha** (Director) confirming nil pledged shares.
Manmohan Pal Singh Chadha, Promoter of Ritco Logistics Limited, declared no new encumbrances on shares as of March 31, 2026, with nil pledged shares.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹391.83 Cr (+13.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹5.95 Cr (-50.3% YoY).
Roma Wadhwa, Promoter of Ritco Logistics Limited, declared no encumbrance or pledge of shares as of March 31, 2026, with nil pledged shares.
Ritco Logistics secured ~₹10.07 crores in new transportation contracts in May 2026 and reported TrucksUp FASTag GMV crossing ₹30 crore.
Ritco Logistics secured ₹119.55 Cr of new business in September 2026, led by major 3-year contracts from BCPL (₹73.67 Cr) and HRRL (₹35.34 Cr).
